newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan Motor leaps on dividend resumption report.
newsitem.headline: Nissan Motor leaps on dividend resumption report.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd shares leaped in Wednesday morning trade, encouraged by media reports of a dividend resumption, brokers said.
As of 0032 GMT, the shares were 15 yen higher at 726.

Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday that Nissan Motor is expected to post a parent current profit of more than 100 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1998, and to resume interim dividend payments in that business year.
The automobile manufacturer said that it has not decided how large the interim dividend for the 1997/98 business year will be.
Japan's second-biggest carmaker has made no interim dividend payment since 1992/93, but it has been paying a full-year dividend of seven yen since 1993/94.
